text: Lena takes Alex to a language-exchange evening. In this unit you will talk about the languages you speak, your work or studies, dates and birthdays, and your family, in places such as a conference, a language-exchange café, the department office and a faculty garden party. You will also meet two new characters: Katrin Huber, a teacher from Linz, and Peter Lange, an engineer from Dortmund.
Start with the dialogues, then move on to vocabulary and grammar.
